metadata.title: Here's How!
metadata.author: Judge Jr.
metadata.source_file: 1927 Here's How by Judge Jr ( 2nd impression).txt
metadata.notes: Pequeño libro humorístico de cócteles publicado durante la Prohibición en EE. UU. Cada receta va acompañada de un brindis (toast) jocoso. Muchas recetas usan 'Gordon water' como eufemismo de ginebra Gordon's.

sections.title: Front Matter
sections.content_original:
Oh, poets sing of steins of ale
    and mugs of old Jamaicer,
But the only vessel for a sail
    Is the good old cocktail shaker!
     From an OLD DRINKING SONG --
     written by myself at the age of ten.

HERE'S HOW!
     By Judge Jr.

      NEW YORK
LESLIE-JUDGE COMPANY
        COPYRIGHT, 1927, BY
      LESLIE-JUDGE COMPANY, NEW YORK
sections.content_es:
Oh, los poetas cantan a las jarras de cerveza
    y a las tazas del viejo Jamaicano,
pero el único bajel apto para zarpar
    ¡es la buena y vieja coctelera!
     De una VIEJA CANCIÓN BÁQUICA --
     escrita por mí mismo a la edad de diez años.

¡HERE'S HOW! (¡Salud!)
     Por Judge Jr.

      NUEVA YORK
LESLIE-JUDGE COMPANY
        COPYRIGHT, 1927, POR
      LESLIE-JUDGE COMPANY, NUEVA YORK

sections.title: Foreword
sections.content_original: Every book should have a 'foreword' they tell me, and unaccustomed as I am to public speaking, which reminds me of the story of the two Irishmen... Like the orange, I owe my success to Prohibition, and like a great many other people I never thought of taking a drink before Prohibition... Of course I was pretty young then, but I can remember one of my favorite childhood verses was 'Old King Cole' which my father used to read to me in the old Knickerbocker Bar... after that we always used to pick orange blossoms at the Astor... In fact my father said, only the other day when we met one of his old cronies, 'why I can remember Junior when he was no higher than the Waldorf Bar!'... But speaking of Prohibition, I sincerely hope this little volume will bring cheer to those of you who try these concoctions and no headaches, and, though we may never meet, I say 'Shake!'
sections.content_es: Todo libro debería tener un 'prólogo', dicen, y, poco acostumbrado como estoy a hablar en público, esto me recuerda la historia de los dos irlandeses... Como la naranja, le debo mi éxito a la Prohibición, y como tantas otras personas, jamás se me había ocurrido beber antes de la Prohibición... Por supuesto, era bastante joven entonces, pero puedo recordar que uno de mis versos infantiles favoritos era 'Old King Cole', que mi padre solía leerme en el viejo Knickerbocker Bar... después siempre solíamos coger flores de naranjo en el Astor... De hecho, mi padre dijo, justo el otro día cuando nos encontramos con uno de sus viejos camaradas: '¡Vaya, recuerdo a Junior cuando no era más alto que la barra del Waldorf!'... Pero hablando de la Prohibición, sinceramente espero que este pequeño volumen lleve alegría a aquellos que prueben estas mezclas y ningún dolor de cabeza, y, aunque tal vez nunca nos conozcamos, les digo: '¡Shake!' ('¡Agita!')

ingredients.notes: 'Gordon water' es eufemismo de ginebra Gordon's

recipes.method_original: This drink, I discovered later, was invented by someone else, but it's good just the same!
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida, descubrí después, fue inventada por otra persona, ¡pero es buena igual! Mezclar todos los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Judge, Jr.
This drink, I discovered later, was invented by someone else, but it's good just the same!
1 part Gordon water; 1 part bacardi; 1 part lemon juice; powdered sugar; a dash of grenadine.
TOAST: Here's to our sons in college; you have to make allowances for them.

recipes.method_original: This title was probably selected because it takes more than one swallow to make a summer.
recipes.method_es: Este título probablemente fue elegido porque se necesita más de un trago para hacer un verano. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
A Summer Cocktail
This title was probably selected because it takes more than one swallow to make a summer:
1 jigger of Canadian Club; the juice of a lemon; a dash of grenadine.
TOAST: Here's to the doctors prescriptions—fill 'em up again!

recipes.method_original: A vera, vera tricky drink, contributed by the University of Indiana: Glass of cracked ice; 1 jigger of Gordon water; the juice of a lime; take a bottle of ginger ale, and holding the finger over the neck of the bottle, shake said bottle—and then let the finger off just enough to let a fine stream sizz into the highball glass.
recipes.method_es: Una bebida muy, muy traicionera, aportada por la Universidad de Indiana: vaso con hielo picado; 1 jigger de ginebra Gordon's; el zumo de una lima; tomar una botella de ginger ale, taparla con el dedo, agitarla y luego soltar el dedo lo suficiente para dejar caer un fino chorro siseante dentro del vaso highball.
recipes.raw_text:
The Indiana Fizz
A vera, vera tricky drink, contributed by the University of Indiana:
Glass of cracked ice; 1 jigger of Gordon water; the juice of a lime; take a bottle of ginger ale, and holding the finger over the neck of the bottle, shake said bottle—and then let the finger off just enough to let a fine stream sizz into the highball glass.
TOAST: Here's to our relatives; may God keep them—away!

recipes.method_original: This drink proves conclusively that the South isn't so solid! Dampen a small bunch of mint, dust with powdered sugar, bruise and pour over it a little boiling water; strain into a tall, thin glass; fill the glass with finely cracked ice; fill with brandy; add sprigs of mint and serve with straws.
recipes.method_es: ¡Esta bebida demuestra de forma concluyente que el Sur no es tan sólido! Humedecer un pequeño manojo de menta, espolvorear con azúcar en polvo, machacar y verter encima un poco de agua hirviendo; colar en un vaso alto y estrecho; llenar el vaso con hielo finamente picado; llenar con brandy; añadir ramitas de menta y servir con pajitas.
recipes.raw_text:
The Mint Julep
This drink proves conclusively that the South isn't so solid!
Dampen a small bunch of mint, dust with powdered sugar, bruise and pour over it a little boiling water; strain into a tall, thin glass; fill the glass with finely cracked ice; fill with brandy; add sprigs of mint and serve with straws.
TOAST: Here's to our hills—and may we some day meet 'em.

recipes.method_original: This is one of the common or garden variety of cocktails—with the pineapple added to give it a piquant touch.
recipes.method_es: Este es uno de los cócteles comunes o caseros, con la piña añadida para darle un toque picante. Mezclar y agitar con hielo.
recipes.raw_text:
The Pineapple Bronx
This is one of the common or garden variety of cocktails—with the pineapple added to give it a piquant touch:
1 part Gordon water; 1 part French vermouth; 1 part pineapple juice; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to that august body—the bathing girl.

recipes.method_original: This is called the Hawaiian Sunset because it goes down at 6 o'clock.
recipes.method_es: Se llama Atardecer Hawaiano porque se baja a las 6 en punto. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Hawaiian Sunset
This is called the Hawaiian Sunset because it goes down at 6 o'clock:
1 part of apricot brandy; 2 parts of Gordon water; 1 part of plain water or vichy.
TOAST: A little woman is a dangerous thing!

recipes.method_original: This is a Cuban catastrophe; so easy with the whip.
recipes.method_es: Esta es una catástrofe cubana; vaya con cuidado al agitar. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The President
This is a Cuban catastrophe; so easy with the whip:
2/3 Gordon water; 1/6 pineapple syrup; 1/6 lime juice; a dash of rum flavoring extract.
TOAST: Here's to father—the 'kin' you love to touch!

recipes.method_original: Try counting sheep after two or three of these!
recipes.method_es: ¡Pruebe a contar ovejas después de dos o tres de estos! Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
Sleepy Time Gal
Try counting sheep after two or three of these!
2 parts of Gordon water; 1 part of grape juice; 1 part of orange juice; 2 limes; a dash of grenadine.
TOAST: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved and won.

recipes.method_original: Contributed by one Edwin Bertuch and guaranteed to make you feel like a windmill. [pooshumup, Tony!]
recipes.method_es: Aportada por un tal Edwin Bertuch y garantizada para hacerle sentir como un molino de viento. ¡Empújalo, Tony! Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Hollander
Contributed by one Edwin Bertuch and guaranteed to make you feel like a windmill:
1 part of Holland gin; 4 parts of apricot brandy; 2 parts of grape juice; a bit of cracked ice—[pooshumup, Tony!]
TOAST: Here's to the old-fashioned girl who used to stay home when she had nothing to wear!

recipes.method_original: This little drink is called the Quaker because it knows its oats.
recipes.method_es: Esta bebidita se llama Cuáquero porque sabe lo que se hace (juego con 'knows its oats'). Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Quaker
This little drink is called the Quaker because it knows its oats:
3 parts of chilled cocoanut milk; 1 part Gordon water; 1 dash of lime juice; a dash of grated nutmeg.
TOAST: Here's to football—for God, for country, and for kale!

recipes.method_original: Don't get near a fire after drinking one of these! Fill highball glasses half full of this mixture and fill up with vichy or seltzer.
recipes.method_es: ¡No se acerque al fuego después de beber uno de estos! Llenar vasos highball hasta la mitad con esta mezcla y completar con vichy o seltz.
recipes.raw_text:
The Corn Popper
Don't get near a fire after drinking one of these!
1 pint of corn (Georgia or Maryland); ½ pint of cream; the whites of two eggs; 1 tablespoonful of grenadine; fill highball glasses half full of this mixture and fill up with vichy or seltzer.
TOAST: Here's to the blonde—we love her henna-way.

recipes.method_original: L. J. Maloney, the inventor, doesn't state why this is called The Wild Cherry. So we will let you find out for yourself.
recipes.method_es: L. J. Maloney, el inventor, no dice por qué se llama La Cereza Silvestre. Así que te dejaremos descubrirlo por ti mismo. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Wild Cherry
L. J. Maloney, the inventor, doesn't state why this is called The Wild Cherry. So we will let you find out for yourself:
3 limes; 1 quart of carbonated water; 1 glass of Gordon water; enough wild cherry to flavor.
TOAST: Down with the reformers—their motto is 'mirth control!'

recipes.method_original: After trying this drink I am glad to state that there is nothing at all sissy about it. This is the same as The Wild Cherry: only substitute bacardi for Gordon water.
recipes.method_es: Después de probar esta bebida me alegra decir que no tiene nada de afeminado. Es igual que The Wild Cherry: solo sustituye el Gordon water por bacardi.
recipes.raw_text:
The Woolly Boy
After trying this drink I am glad to state that there is nothing at all sissy about it. This is the same as The Wild Cherry:
[See page facing] only substitute bacardi for Gordon water.
TOAST: Here's to the taxicab driver; he takes life easily!

recipes.method_original: 'Ain't it wonderful! How do I know? Why, gentle reader, I'm tellin' you so!'
recipes.method_es: '¿No es maravilloso? ¿Cómo lo sé? Pues, amable lector, ¡te lo estoy diciendo yo!' Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Golden Gate
'Ain't it wonderful! How do I know? Why, gentle reader, I'm tellin' you so!'
¼ of that stuff that rhymes with McCardy; ¼ Gordon water; ¼ lemon juice; ¼ ginger ale; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to the married woman—who marries in haste and repents in Paris!

recipes.method_original: This mixture is guaranteed to tear down any good-sized building.
recipes.method_es: Esta mezcla está garantizada para derribar cualquier edificio de buen tamaño. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Village Architect
This mixture is guaranteed to tear down any good-sized building:
⅓ tangerine juice; ⅓ Gordon water; ⅓ vichy.
TOAST: Here's to our flappers; they are more ginned against than ginning!

recipes.method_original: Little, of Cornell, claims that this beverage is as smooth as the hair on a silkworm.
recipes.method_es: Little, de Cornell, afirma que esta bebida es tan suave como el pelo de un gusano de seda. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Cornell Special
Little, of Cornell, claims that this beverage is as smooth as the hair on a silkworm:
¼ part of benedictine; ¼ part of Gordon water; ¼ part lemon; ¼ part lithia water.
TOAST: Here's to a red nose; it indicates a horn of plenty these days!

recipes.method_original: We don't know why this is called 'The Quarantine,' but after having tried a few we don't care. Serve in cocktail glasses or what have you?
recipes.method_es: No sabemos por qué se llama 'La Cuarentena', pero después de probar unos cuantos no nos importa. Servir en copas de cóctel o lo que tenga a mano.
recipes.raw_text:
The Quarantine
We don't know why this is called 'The Quarantine,' but after having tried a few we don't care:
½ glass of bacardi; 1 glass of lemon juice; ¼ glass of Gordon water; ¼ glass of French vermouth; 3 spoonfuls of powdered sugar; the white of an egg; cracked ice. Serve in cocktail glasses or what have you?
TOAST: Here's to prohibition enforcement; the results are staggering.

recipes.method_original: This drink is really what won the War for the Allies. Fill up the rest of a tall glass with champagne! [If you use club soda instead of champagne, you have a Tom Collins.]
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida es realmente lo que ganó la Guerra para los Aliados. ¡Rellene el resto de un vaso alto con champán! [Si usa soda en lugar de champán, tendrá un Tom Collins.]
recipes.raw_text:
The French '75'
This drink is really what won the War for the Allies:
2 jiggers Gordon water; 1 part lemon juice; a spoonful of powdered sugar; cracked ice. Fill up the rest of a tall glass with champagne! [If you use club soda instead of champagne, you have a Tom Collins.]
TOAST: Here's to present day culture—which doesn't care about your English if your Scotch is all right!

recipes.method_original: Hark, ye lads! Here's the very latest drink! Three of these will knock you for a row of aspirins.
recipes.method_es: ¡Escuchad, muchachos! ¡Aquí está la bebida más nueva! Tres de estos te dejarán fuera de combate (literalmente, 'te tumbarán para una hilera de aspirinas'). Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
De Riguer
Hark, ye lads! Here's the very latest drink! Three of these will knock you for a row of aspirins:
⅓ Scotch; ⅓ grapefruit juice; ⅓ honey; cracked ice.
TOAST: You don't have to look at a clothes line these days to see what the women are wearing!

recipes.method_original: Invented by Tom Irby, the sheik of Anniston, Ala., who says you must use mo' corn than mo' 'lasses, and if you have no 'lasses drink mo' corn!
recipes.method_es: Inventado por Tom Irby, el jeque de Anniston, Alabama, quien dice que debes usar más corn (maíz) que más melaza, y si no tienes melaza, ¡bebe más corn! Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Tom-Tom
Invented by Tom Irby, the sheik of Anniston, Ala., who says you must use mo' corn than mo' 'lasses, and if you have no 'lasses drink mo' corn!
½ corn; ½ molasses.
TOAST: Here's to Peggy Joyce; long may she wive!

recipes.method_original: This concoction sounds very domestic but, boy, it will make you far from domestic! 1 pound of cranberries (4 cups full) boiled in 3 quarts of water until soft; drain through three thicknesses of cheesecloth and then stir in one cup and a half of sugar for each quart. Serve with slice of orange or mint leaf.
recipes.method_es: Esta mezcla suena muy doméstica pero, vaya, te dejará lejos de lo doméstico. Hervir 1 libra de arándanos rojos (4 tazas) en 3 cuartos de agua hasta que estén blandos; colar a través de tres capas de gasa y luego incorporar una taza y media de azúcar por cada cuarto. Mezclar con la ginebra y el zumo de limón. Servir con una rodaja de naranja u hoja de menta.
recipes.garnish: rodaja de naranja u hoja de menta
recipes.raw_text:
The Cranberry Flip
This concoction sounds very domestic but, boy, it will make you far from domestic!
1 pound of cranberries (4 cups full) boiled in 3 quarts of water until soft; drain through three thicknesses of cheesecloth and then stir in one cup and a half of sugar for each quart; 2 parts of cranberry juice; 1 part of Gordon gin; the juice of a lemon. Serve with slice of orange or mint leaf.
TOAST: Here's to Wayne B. Wheeler—this is one on him.

recipes.method_original: All you need for this drink, is a flask of corn and a drug store.
recipes.method_es: Todo lo que necesitas para esta bebida es una petaca de whisky de maíz y una droguería. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
Coca-Corn
All you need for this drink, is a flask of corn and a drug store:
½ corn; ½ Coca-Cola.
TOAST: Here's to the dieters; don't give up the shape!

recipes.method_original: This drink was graciously contributed by Mr. Cadman, to whom we give thanks. Serve in a highball glass.
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida fue amablemente aportada por el Sr. Cadman, a quien damos las gracias. Servir en un vaso highball.
recipes.raw_text:
A Bacardi Punch
This drink was graciously contributed by Mr. Cadman, to whom we give thanks:
1 jigger of bacardi; 1 glass of hot milk; 1 tablespoonful of sugar; a pinch of grated nutmeg; the yolk of an egg. Serve in a highball glass.
TOAST: Here's looking at you—double!

recipes.method_original: This recipe is printed in response to 9,865 people who asked how to make it.
recipes.method_es: Esta receta se publica en respuesta a 9.865 personas que preguntaron cómo hacerla. Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Bacardi Cocktail
This recipe is printed in response to 9,865 people who asked how to make it:
2 parts bacardi; 1 part lime juice; a dash of grenadine; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to the tightwad who hides a pair of socks in the pocket of his pajamas in order to cut down his laundry bill!

recipes.method_original: This drink is very popular because it's so easy to mix if you are out dancing. In fact, you can mix it in the ginger ale bottles at home and put them right up on the table.
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida es muy popular porque es muy fácil de mezclar si estás bailando fuera. De hecho, puedes mezclarla en las botellas de ginger ale en casa y ponerlas directamente sobre la mesa.
recipes.raw_text:
The Padlock
This drink is very popular because it's so easy to mix if you are out dancing. In fact, you can mix it in the ginger ale bottles at home and put them right up on the table:
½ ginger ale; ½ Gordon water.
TOAST: Here's to the bachelor; you can always tell him because he has no buttons on his shirt. A married man has no shirt?

ingredients.notes: el zumo de un limón grande

recipes.method_original: Contributed by Ed Flynn of Bridgewater, Mass. (the town with a future!): Take half a pint of 'what have you,' ¼ pound of sugar; the juice of a large lemon; light this mixture and while it is blazing pour on it a quart of tea.
recipes.method_es: Aportada por Ed Flynn de Bridgewater, Mass. (¡la ciudad con futuro!): tomar media pinta de 'lo que tengas', 1/4 de libra de azúcar; el zumo de un limón grande; encender esta mezcla y mientras arde verter sobre ella un cuarto de té.
recipes.raw_text:
A Tea Punch
Contributed by Ed Flynn of Bridgewater, Mass. (the town with a future!):
Take half a pint of 'what have you,' ¼ pound of sugar; the juice of a large lemon; light this mixture and while it is blazing pour on it a quart of tea.
TOAST: Here's to the 'shingle'—it's so close to the wood!

recipes.method_original: This drink was originated on the Pacific Coast, to get people used to earthquakes. Serve in a highball glass.
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida fue originada en la Costa del Pacífico para acostumbrar a la gente a los terremotos. Servir en un vaso highball.
recipes.raw_text:
The Barbary Coast
This drink was originated on the Pacific Coast, to get people used to earthquakes:
¼ Gordon water; ¼ scotch; ¼ creme de cocoa; ¼ cream; cracked ice. Serve in a highball glass.
TOAST: To pedestrians; here's honking at you!

recipes.method_original: This one I discovered myself, due to the fact that that's all there was in the ice box!
recipes.method_es: ¡Este lo descubrí yo mismo, debido al hecho de que era todo lo que había en la nevera! Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Razzberry
This one I discovered myself, due to the fact that that's all there was in the ice box!
⅓ Gordon water; ⅓ raspberry juice; the juice of a lemon.
TOAST: Here's to face powder; it has put more men down and out than gun powder!

recipes.method_original: This concoction is all that the name implies and should be mixed in a cyclone cellar.
recipes.method_es: Esta mezcla es todo lo que el nombre implica y debería mezclarse en un refugio antitornados.
recipes.raw_text:
The Hurricane
This concoction is all that the name implies and should be mixed in a cyclone cellar:
½ pint of Johnnie Walker; ½ pint of Gordon gin; ½ pint of Creme de Menthe; the juice of two lemons.
TOAST: Here's to 'Block & Tackle' whiskey—take a drink, walk a block and tackle anything!

recipes.method_original: You will be able to do figure 8's and everything else after a few of these! Scrape from a cake of ice a saucerful of same, add 2 or 3 or 4 or 5 teaspoonfuls of rye, and serve like dessert.
recipes.method_es: ¡Podrá hacer ochos y todo lo demás después de unos cuantos de estos! Raspe de un bloque de hielo un platillo lleno, añada 2, 3, 4 o 5 cucharaditas de whisky de centeno y sirva como postre.
recipes.raw_text:
The Ice of Youth
You will be able to do figure 8's and everything else after a few of these!
Scrape from a cake of ice a saucerful of same, add 2 or 3 or 4 or 5 teaspoonfuls of rye, and serve like dessert.
TOAST: To our country—which needs less concrete in the drivers' heads and more in the road-beds.

recipes.method_original: This is probably so named because it brightens the corner where you are! Fill the highball glass with ginger ale.
recipes.method_es: ¡Probablemente se llama así porque ilumina la esquina donde estás! Mezclar los ingredientes y rellenar el vaso highball con ginger ale.
recipes.raw_text:
The Brighton
This is probably so named because it brightens the corner where you are!
1 jigger of Gordon water; lemon to flavor; 1 teaspoonful of sugar; ¼ glass of Angostura bitters; fill the highball glass with ginger ale.
TOAST: Synthetic complexion, synthetic gin, and next, I suppose, is synthetic sin!

recipes.method_original: No wisecrack goes with this beverage. (good for 4 to 6 cocktails.)
recipes.method_es: Ningún chiste acompaña a esta bebida. (rinde para 4 a 6 cócteles). Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Hay Market
No wisecrack goes with this beverage:
½ Canadian Club; ½ orange juice; the white of an egg. (good for 4 to 6 cocktails.)
TOAST: Here's to the bathing girl—she certainly isn't all wet!

recipes.method_original: Invented by one James Norton of Princeton and guaranteed to go down with the ease of an elevator: Place a pinch of salt on the back of the right hand and with the same north paw hold half a lemon between thumb and forefinger. Hold a small glass of Gordon water in the left hand and follow this sequence: lick the salt, drink the Gordon water and suck the lemon!
recipes.method_es: Inventado por un tal James Norton de Princeton y garantizado para bajar con la facilidad de un ascensor: ponga una pizca de sal en el dorso de la mano derecha y con la misma mano sostenga medio limón entre el pulgar y el índice. Sostenga un vasito de ginebra Gordon's en la mano izquierda y siga esta secuencia: lama la sal, beba la ginebra y chupe el limón.
recipes.raw_text:
The Swiss Itch
Invented by one James Norton of Princeton and guaranteed to go down with the ease of an elevator:
Place a pinch of salt on the back of the right hand and with the same north paw hold half a lemon between thumb and forefinger. Hold a small glass of Gordon water in the left hand and follow this sequence: lick the salt, drink the Gordon water and suck the lemon!
TOAST: Here's to the pedestrian; every year is leap year with him!

recipes.method_original: Here's another drink that comes out of the South and makes you believe in Evolution.
recipes.method_es: Aquí hay otra bebida que viene del Sur y te hace creer en la Evolución. Mezclar todos los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Louisiana Fizz
Here's another drink that comes out of the South and makes you believe in Evolution:
1 cup of white of an egg; 1 cup of powdered sugar; 1 cup of lemon juice; 2 cups of Gordon water; 1 teaspoonful of cream; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to Chicago—have a thot!

recipes.method_original: This was originated at the Ritz in Paris, and is supposed to be very high hat: Saturate a lump of sugar in bitters (Baker's preferred), add a piece of lemon peel and fill the cocktail glass with champagne.
recipes.method_es: Esto fue originado en el Ritz de París y se supone que es de muy alta clase: empape un terrón de azúcar en amargo (preferiblemente Baker's), añada un trozo de piel de limón y llene la copa de cóctel con champán.
recipes.raw_text:
The Champagne Cocktail
This was originated at the Ritz in Paris, and is supposed to be very high hat:
Saturate a lump of sugar in bitters (Baker's preferred), add a piece of lemon peel and fill the cocktail glass with champagne.
TOAST: Here's to prohibition—drink her down!

recipes.method_original: After two of these you won't even need a horse. Ride 'em, cowboy!
recipes.method_es: ¡Después de dos de estos ni siquiera necesitarás un caballo. Cabálgalos, vaquero! Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Cowboy
After two of these you won't even need a horse. Ride 'em, cowboy!
2 parts scotch; 1 part cream; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to the liquor that makes a man see double and feel single!

recipes.method_original: This drink comes straight from dear old England, and after trying several we now understand why Britannia rules the waves: No directions for this, just empty the contents of the shaker into a pan and heat.
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida viene directamente de la querida y vieja Inglaterra, y después de probar varias ahora entendemos por qué Britania rige las olas: no hay indicaciones para esto, simplemente vacíe el contenido de la coctelera en una sartén y caliente.
recipes.raw_text:
The Hot Cocktail
This drink comes straight from dear old England, and after trying several we now understand why Britannia rules the waves:
No directions for this, just empty the contents of the shaker into a pan and heat.
TOAST: Here's to John D. Rockefeller—may he always have a good dime.

recipes.method_original: Invented by Dick Merriwell of Punxsutawney. Try saying 'Punxsutawney' after three of these! 2 heaping tablespoonfuls of vanilla ice cream, stirred into creamy substance; add 1 jigger of Gordon water and fill the highball glass with ginger ale.
recipes.method_es: Inventado por Dick Merriwell de Punxsutawney. ¡Intenta decir 'Punxsutawney' después de tres de estos! 2 cucharadas colmadas de helado de vainilla, removido hasta una sustancia cremosa; añadir 1 jigger de ginebra Gordon's y llenar el vaso highball con ginger ale.
recipes.raw_text:
The Punxsutawney Cooler
Invented by Dick Merriwell of Punxsutawney. Try saying 'Punxsutawney' after three of these!
2 heaping tablespoonfuls of vanilla ice cream, stirred into creamy substance; add 1 jigger of Gordon water and fill the highball glass with ginger ale.
TOAST: Here's to the flapper; may she keep that fool-girl complexion!

recipes.method_original: This is only to be imbibed on holiday occasions: Thoroughly beat an egg with one-half of a teaspoonful of sugar; add 1 jigger of brandy or whiskey; shake in a shaker and add milk to taste; pour into a glass and twist a lemon peel over it.
recipes.method_es: Solo se debe beber en ocasiones festivas: bata bien un huevo con media cucharadita de azúcar; añada 1 jigger de brandy o whisky; agite en una coctelera y añada leche al gusto; vierta en un vaso y retuerza una piel de limón por encima.
recipes.raw_text:
An Egg Nog
This is only to be imbibed on holiday occasions:
Thoroughly beat an egg with one-half of a teaspoonful of sugar; add 1 jigger of brandy or whiskey; shake in a shaker and add milk to taste; pour into a glass and twist a lemon peel over it.
TOAST: Here's to the optimist who takes his crank off the Ford!

recipes.method_original: Invented by old 'Midnight' Murphy, Notre Dame '24, Rah, Rah, Rah!
recipes.method_es: Inventado por el viejo 'Midnight' Murphy, Notre Dame promoción '24, ¡Rah, Rah, Rah! Mezclar todos los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Notre Dame Special
Invented by old 'Midnight' Murphy, Notre Dame '24, Rah, Rah, Rah!
1 pint of Gordon water; 3 teaspoonfuls of absinthe; 1 pint of muscatel; the juice of four oranges.
TOAST: Here's to the Prohibitionist; let him without gin cast the first stone.

recipes.method_original: This combination is a great favorite of the South and is probably what caused the Civil War.
recipes.method_es: Esta combinación es una gran favorita del Sur y probablemente fue lo que causó la Guerra Civil. Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
The Southern Exposure
This combination is a great favorite of the South and is probably what caused the Civil War:
½ Gordon water; ½ Coca-Cola; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to love; it may be blind but mostly it just doesn't give a damn!

ingredients.item_es: whisky de centeno, brandy o ron

recipes.method_original: This is included for Grandma and Grandpa: 1 jigger of rye, brandy or rum; the juice of half a lemon; 1 lump of sugar; fill up the highball glass with hot water.
recipes.method_es: Esto está incluido para la abuela y el abuelo: 1 jigger de whisky de centeno, brandy o ron; el zumo de medio limón; 1 terrón de azúcar; rellenar el vaso highball con agua caliente.
recipes.raw_text:
A Hot Toddy
This is included for Grandma and Grandpa:
1 jigger of rye, brandy or rum; the juice of half a lemon; 1 lump of sugar; fill up the highball glass with hot water.
TOAST: Here's to the modern grandmother; may she never pass out.

recipes.method_original: Great care should be taken with this one, or you will be carried out.
recipes.method_es: Hay que tener mucho cuidado con este, o saldrá cargado (juego con 'carried out'). Mezclar los ingredientes en proporción.
recipes.raw_text:
The Carry On
Great care should be taken with this one, or you will be carried out:
50 percent green chartreuse; 40 percent Italian vermouth; 10 percent Gordon water; the juice of a lemon.
TOAST: Here's to Adam, the radio inventor; he made a broadcasting station out of a rib!

recipes.method_original: This baby is sponsored by the University of Wisconsin, no less, so it ought to be good. [P.S. It is!]: 1 part French vermouth; 2 parts made with equal parts of Bourbon, Gordon water and brandy; a dash of orange bitters.
recipes.method_es: Este bebé está patrocinado por la Universidad de Wisconsin, nada menos, así que tiene que ser bueno. [P.D. ¡Lo es!]: 1 parte de vermut francés; 2 partes hechas con partes iguales de Bourbon, ginebra Gordon's y brandy; un dash de amargo de naranja.
recipes.raw_text:
The Chile Bean
This baby is sponsored by the University of Wisconsin, no less, so it ought to be good. [P.S. It is!]:
1 part French vermouth; 2 parts made with equal parts of Bourbon, Gordon water and brandy; a dash of orange bitters.
TOAST: Hips that touch liquor shall never fall down!

ingredients.notes: véase cualquier puesto de bebidas de piña

recipes.method_original: Discovered this one myself and am quite proud of it: 1 glass of pineapple drink (see any pineapple drink stand); 1 jigger of Gordon water. [P.S. This is also good with a shot of benedictine.]
recipes.method_es: Descubrí este yo mismo y estoy bastante orgulloso de él: 1 vaso de bebida de piña (véase cualquier puesto de bebidas de piña); 1 jigger de ginebra Gordon's. [P.D. También está bueno con un chorro de benedictine.]
recipes.raw_text:
The Pineapple Fizz
Discovered this one myself and am quite proud of it:
1 glass of pineapple drink (see any pineapple drink stand); 1 jigger of Gordon water. [P.S. This is also good with a shot of benedictine.]
TOAST: Here's to low necks and short skirts—may they never meet.

recipes.method_original: For the benefit of our young readers who never drank before Prohibition we will give a list of the cocktails of the good old days.
recipes.method_es: Para beneficio de nuestros jóvenes lectores que nunca bebieron antes de la Prohibición, daremos una lista de los cócteles de los buenos viejos tiempos. Mezclar los ingredientes con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
Old Reliables — DRY MARTINI:
1 part Gordon water; 1 part French vermouth; cracked ice.

recipes.method_original: MANHATTAN: 1 part rye; 1 part Italian vermouth; a dash of grenadine; cracked ice.
recipes.method_es: MANHATTAN: 1 parte de whisky de centeno; 1 parte de vermut italiano; un dash de granadina; hielo picado. Mezclar.
recipes.raw_text:
Old Reliables — MANHATTAN:
1 part rye; 1 part Italian vermouth; a dash of grenadine; cracked ice.

recipes.method_original: CLOVER CLUB: 1 jigger of Gordon water; the white of an egg; the juice of a lemon; a dash of grenadine.
recipes.method_es: CLOVER CLUB: 1 jigger de ginebra Gordon's; la clara de un huevo; el zumo de un limón; un dash de granadina. Agitar bien.
recipes.raw_text:
Old Reliables — CLOVER CLUB:
1 jigger of Gordon water; the white of an egg; the juice of a lemon; a dash of grenadine.

recipes.method_original: BRONX: 1 part Gordon water; 1 part orange juice; 1 part French vermouth; cracked ice.
recipes.method_es: BRONX: 1 parte de ginebra Gordon's; 1 parte de zumo de naranja; 1 parte de vermut francés; hielo picado. Mezclar.
recipes.raw_text:
Old Reliables — BRONX:
1 part Gordon water; 1 part orange juice; 1 part French vermouth; cracked ice.
TOAST: Here's to our wives; they are like cider—the longer you leave them standing around, the more of a kick you get!

recipes.method_original: This is really very mid-Victorian, but it ought to be included.
recipes.method_es: Este es realmente muy victoriano medio, pero debería incluirse. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Whiskey Sour
This is really very mid-Victorian, but it ought to be included:
1 jigger of rye; the juice of half a lemon; a piece of lemon peel; a dash of sweet syrup.
TOAST: Here's to our bootlegger—he's never low in spirits!

recipes.method_original: This drink would make a flapper flapper wings—if she had any! [Mix the fruit with sherry and let stand 48 hours; then add Gordon water and 1 quart of plain water—and see how long it stands!]
recipes.method_es: ¡Esta bebida le haría flappear las alas a una flapper, si tuviera! [Mezclar la fruta con el jerez y dejar reposar 48 horas; luego añadir la ginebra Gordon's y 1 cuarto de agua natural, ¡y ver cuánto aguanta!]
recipes.raw_text:
The Flapper's Delight
This drink would make a flapper flapper wings—if she had any!
1 quart of sherry; 6 oranges; 1 can of pineapple; 3 lemons; 1 pint of cherries; 1 pint of Gordon water. [Mix the fruit with sherry and let stand 48 hours; then add Gordon water and 1 quart of plain water—and see how long it stands!]
TOAST: Here's to Prohibition; hippy days!

recipes.method_original: This drink is guaranteed to make you fly; like the crow, if you fly too far you will get shot!
recipes.method_es: Esta bebida está garantizada para hacerte volar; como el cuervo, si vuelas demasiado lejos te dispararán. Mezclar los ingredientes.
recipes.raw_text:
The Crow
This drink is guaranteed to make you fly; like the crow, if you fly too far you will get shot!
½ Scotch; ½ lemon juice; a dash of grenadine.
TOAST: Here's to woman—a flood of loveliness—dam her!

ingredients.notes: si la mezcla queda demasiado espesa

recipes.method_original: Here's a concoction that's endorsed by all the ice cream manufacturers. And, take it from me it's a rare beverage! No ice is necessary; just shake until thoroughly mixed, and add water or white wine if the concoction is too thick.
recipes.method_es: Aquí tienes una mezcla respaldada por todos los fabricantes de helado. Y, créeme, ¡es una bebida poco común! No es necesario hielo; simplemente agítese hasta que esté bien mezclado, y añada agua o vino blanco si la mezcla queda demasiado espesa.
recipes.raw_text:
The White Cargo
Here's a concoction that's endorsed by all the ice cream manufacturers. And, take it from me it's a rare beverage!
½ vanilla ice cream; ½ Gordon water; no ice is necessary; just shake until thoroughly mixed, and add water or white wine if the concoction is too thick.
TOAST: Here's to your car and my car—may they never meet.

recipes.method_original: This nifty little drink is contributed by Mr. Converse. Give this lad a hand: Cut a square hole out of a watermelon. Pour into the aperture a quantity of Gordon gin, then replace the aforementioned hunk of watermelon and let said melon stand in the ice box a few hours.
recipes.method_es: Esta ingeniosa bebidita la aporta el Sr. Converse. Aplauda a este muchacho: corte un agujero cuadrado en una sandía. Vierta en la abertura una cantidad de ginebra Gordon's, luego vuelva a colocar el trozo mencionado de sandía y deje la sandía en la nevera unas horas.
recipes.raw_text:
The Melon-Choly Cure
This nifty little drink is contributed by Mr. Converse. Give this lad a hand:
Cut a square hole out of a watermelon. Pour into the aperture a quantity of Gordon gin, then replace the aforementioned hunk of watermelon and let said melon stand in the ice box a few hours.
TOAST: Here's to home; be it ever so mortgaged there's no place like it!
